decisions.quote: Incontrast to Lee’s results, I found enhancement did not significantlyincrease form correction gain scores, nor did enhancement significantly detractfrom comprehension. There was no trade-off effect. Form learning andcomprehension did not correlate.
decisions.reason: The abstract states two findings from the original study by Lee (2007)—that textual enhancement improved passive form correction and worsened reading comprehension (a trade-off effect)—and explicitly reports that neither finding held in the replication ('Incontrast to Lee’s results, I found enhancement did not significantlyincrease form correction gain scores, nor did enhancement significantly detractfrom comprehension. There was no trade-off effect.'). The eye-movement noticing result is a new extension compared against Sharwood Smith's (1991, 1993) theoretical proposal rather than a finding reported by Lee (2007). Because all comparisons to the target original disagree, the outcome under the codebook is 'failed', not 'mixed'.
